rows.question: I am in Surau Al Mahdi, how can I walk to Surau At Taqwa?
rows.text:
Route status: likely OK (estimated from map data, not checked)
The walking route from Surau Al Mahdi to Surau At Taqwa is about 364 m, roughly 5 minutes on foot. It runs mainly along Jalan Metafasa U16/3 and includes one unmarked road crossing.
1. Start at Surau Al Mahdi and walk to the nearest mapped path to it.
2. Follow Jalan Metafasa U16/3 for most of the route (about 352 m along the road).
3. Cross the one unmarked road crossing.
4. Arrive at the nearest mapped path to Surau At Taqwa.
Worth knowing:
• Likely OK sections are estimated from map data, not checked on site.
• About 352 m follows road centre lines without a mapped sidewalk; sidewalk access is not verified.
• This route uses 1 road crossing: 1 unmarked (map data, not checked).
